description: This file contains unit tests for the class ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategy, specifically testing its behavior when applying placeholder substitutions within ModifyAclEntry commands in the context of ACL entry modifications.

classes.name: ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for Verify behavior of ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategy, especially placeholder handling in ACL entry modifications.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that the apply method returns the same command instance when no placeholders are present in the ACL entry.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that the apply method replaces placeholders in the ACL entry when present, resulting in an updated command instance.
